about: Weekly caretaker scan. Install it through the existing automations API (POST /v1/jarvis/owner/automations with this whole object as the body, or the console's Automations screen). It is created PAUSED (enabled false): it runs only after the owner presses Resume on it in the console. It is a lab task, so the scan runs in the lab with public-lane models, never on the owner's machines or the Linux test server.

action.goal: Weekly caretaker scan of every tool JARVIS uses; new findings become pull-request tasks for the owner
action.instructions:
Run the JARVIS caretaker once.
1. Clone the repository named in ~/.config/jarvis-caretaker/config.json (field repo_url) into this workspace, or fetch and check out origin/main if a clone is already here.
2. From the repository root run: python3 -m jarvis.caretaker.run --config ~/.config/jarvis-caretaker/config.json
3. Copy the lines it prints (the summary with counts by kind and severity, the task ids it created and the notes) into EVIDENCE.md, exactly as printed.
Rules: do not change any file in the repository and do not open pull requests yourself; the caretaker creates one task per finding and each of those works on its own branch. Never push to main, never force-push, never merge. Never print or copy the token file named in the config.
criteria: EVIDENCE.md contains the caretaker's printed summary line (caretaker run ..., findings ..., by kind ...) and its tasks line, exactly as printed by the run
git status in the clone shows no changes: the scan itself changed no repository file
